// ============================================================
// CLASSIFICATION LOGIC
// ============================================================

function determine_status(industries_str) {
  if (typeof industries_str !== "string" || industries_str.trim() === "") return "Irrelevant";

  const industries = industries_str.split(",").map(i => i.trim());

  // Step 1: Red flag check — any red flag = Irrelevant immediately
  for (const ind of industries) {
    if (red_flag_industries.has(ind)) return "Irrelevant";
  }

  // Step 2: Score each industry
  let score = 0, tech_count = 0, non_tech_count = 0;
  for (const ind of industries) {
    if (score_negative_industries.has(ind)) score -= 1;
    if (score_non_tech_industries.has(ind)) { score += 1; non_tech_count += 1; }
    if (score_tech_industries.has(ind))     { score += 1; tech_count += 1; }
  }

  // Step 3: Final decision
  if (score < 0) return "Irrelevant";
  if (score === 0 && tech_count === 0 && non_tech_count === 0) return "Irrelevant";
  if (tech_count > non_tech_count) return "Tech";
  if (non_tech_count > tech_count) return "Non-Tech";
  return "Tech"; // Tie-breaker: equal counts → Tech (matches Python)
}

// ============================================================
// PROCESS COMPANIES
// ============================================================

const companies = $input.all();
return companies.map(item => {
  const industriesStr = item.json.cb_industries;
  const companyIdRaw  = item.json.company_id;
  return {
    json: {
      company_id: companyIdRaw != null ? parseInt(companyIdRaw, 10) : null,
      cb_industries: industriesStr,
      industry_status: determine_status(industriesStr)
    },
  };
});
